title: mut.lines_not_points
mutation_directive: Replace point-sprite rendering with LINE-SEGMENT rendering. Wherever the parent piece uses THREE.Points + PointsMaterial / custom point shader, switch to THREE.LineSegments + LineBasicMaterial (or a custom line shader that supports per-segment color). Each segment connects either (a) consecutive particles along a path, (b) each particle to its nearest neighbor, or (c) each particle to a designated anchor — pick whichever fits the parent's existing form. KEEP the parent's motion law and palette logic. Tune line opacity to 0.08-0.18 and rely on additive blending so the network reads as accumulated linear weight, not noise. The piece should now feel woven instead of dotted.
